subject: DI03005011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Process control manipulates selected inputs to keep process variables at desired conditions despite changes.

Detailed explanation and conditions

Control helps stabilize product quality, throughput, energy use and operating limits. It requires reliable measurement, a suitable control decision and an effective final element. Poorly chosen tuning or a failed sensor can make a loop unstable. Control does not remove the need for mechanical protection, alarms, trained operation or independently specified safety systems.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

બદલાવ છતાં process variables ને desired conditions પર રાખવા selected inputs બદલવાની વ્યવસ્થા Process Control છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Control થી quality, throughput, energy use તથા operating limits stabilize થાય છે. Reliable measurement, યોગ્ય decision તથા effective final element જોઈએ. Wrong tuning અથવા sensor failure loop unstable કરી શકે છે. Mechanical protection, alarms, trained operation તથા specified independent safety systems નો વિકલ્પ નથી.

title.en: Requirements of a good control system

h.en: Requirements of a good control system

body.en:
Definition / principle

A good control system meets its stated performance objectives while remaining stable and safe within operating constraints.

Detailed explanation and conditions

It should have adequate accuracy, acceptable response/settling time, limited overshoot, disturbance rejection and appropriate tracking. It needs reliable sensors, final-element authority, correct action, maintainability and robust performance under expected process changes. Output limits, actuator travel, noise, communication failures and safe fallback behaviour must be considered. No single tuning can guarantee every objective for every plant. The source PDF repeats number6.2; the next card retains its block-diagram topic separately.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Stated performance objectives ને operating constraints અંદર stable/safe રીતે meet કરતી વ્યવસ્થા સારી Control System છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Adequate accuracy, acceptable response/settling, limited overshoot, disturbance rejection તથા tracking જોઈએ. Reliable sensors, final-element authority, correct action, maintainability તથા process changes સામે robustness જરૂરી છે. Output limits, actuator travel, noise, communication failure તથા fallback જુઓ. દરેક plant માટે એક tuning બધાં objectives guarantee નથી કરતું. PDF માં 6.2 બે વાર છે; next card block diagram અલગ રાખે છે.

title.en: Closed-loop block diagram and control terms
title.gu: Closed-loop Block Diagram તથા Control Terms

h.en: Closed-loop block diagram and control terms
h.gu: Closed-loop Block Diagram તથા Control Terms

body.en:
Definition / principle

Set point SP is the desired controlled-variable value. PV is the measured process variable. Error is SP−PV under the declared convention. Controlled variable CV is the quantity to regulate; manipulated variable MV is the process input intentionally varied. A disturbance changes the process without being the intended control action.

Detailed explanation and conditions

The comparator forms error, the controller computes its output, and an actuator/final control element changes MV. The process responds; the sensor/transmitter returns a scaled PV to the comparator. In a heated vessel, CV may be outlet temperature, MV steam flow, and a disturbance inlet temperature or feed flow. Controller output and physical MV are related through the final element but are not identical units. Scale SP and PV consistently before subtraction.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

SP desired controlled-variable value છે. PV measured process variable છે. Declared convention પ્રમાણે Error=SP−PV છે. CV regulate કરાતી quantity અને MV intentionally બદલાતો process input છે. Disturbance intended control action સિવાય process બદલે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Comparator error બનાવે છે. Controller output compute કરે છે અને actuator/final element MV બદલે છે. Process response sensor/transmitter દ્વારા scaled PV તરીકે પાછો આવે છે. Heated vessel માં CV outlet temperature, MV steam flow અને disturbance inlet temperature/feed flow હોઈ શકે છે. Controller output તથા physical MV related છે, પણ same units નથી. SP/PV ને same scaling પર subtraction કરો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition / principle

A servo problem follows a changed set point. A regulatory problem rejects disturbances while maintaining the set point.

Detailed explanation and conditions

A temperature loop moving from80°Cto90°C is a servo task. A feed-temperature change while holding90°C is a regulatory task. The same closed-loop hardware can perform both; the difference is the cause of the required response. Good tracking does not automatically imply equally good disturbance rejection for every tuning.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Set point બદલાય ત્યારે તેને follow કરવો Servo Problem છે. SP સ્થિર રાખીને disturbance reject કરવો Regulatory Problem છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Temperature loop80 થી 90°CSPfollow કરે તે servo છે.90°CSP સ્થિર હોય અને feed temperature બદલાય તો regulatory છે. Same hardware બંને કરી શકે છે. Required response નું કારણ જુદું છે. Good tracking એટલે દરેક tuning પર good disturbance rejection આપમેળે નહીં.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Feedback uses measured process output to correct error. Feedforward uses measured disturbances and a process relationship to compute compensating action.

Detailed explanation and conditions

Feedback reacts after the variable is affected but can reject unmeasured disturbances indirectly. Feedforward can act before a measured disturbance significantly changes the output, but needs a suitable model and cannot correct unknown disturbances/model errors alone. A combined feedforward-plus-feedback system uses anticipatory action with feedback correction; feedforward is not synonymous with every open-loop system.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Feedback measured process output પરથી error correct કરે છે. Feedforward measured disturbance તથા process relationship પરથી compensation કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Feedback variable affect થયા પછી react કરે છે, પણ unmeasured disturbances ને indirect reject કરી શકે છે. Feedforward measured disturbance output બદલે તે પહેલાં action લઈ શકે છે, પણ model જોઈએ અને unknown disturbance/model error એકલું correct ન કરે. Combined FF+FB માં anticipatory action તથા feedback correction બંને મળે છે. Feedforward દરેક open-loop system નો synonym નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

An open-loop system does not use the controlled output measurement to correct its action. A closed-loop system feeds output information back to influence action.

Detailed explanation and conditions

A timed heater without temperature feedback is open loop; its result changes with load and supply conditions. A thermostat-controlled heater is closed loop because temperature affects switching. Open loop can be simple and economical but cannot automatically correct unexpected output errors. Feedback improves correction when well designed, but adds sensor/actuator dependence and possible instability from wrong action or excessive gain.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Open-loop system controlled output measurement થી પોતાનું action correct કરતી નથી. Closed-loop system output information feedback કરીને action બદલે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Temperature feedback વગર timed heater open loop છે; load/supply બદલાય તો result બદલાય છે. Thermostat heater closed loop છે કારણ કે temperature switching બદલે છે. Open loop simple/economical છે, પણ unexpected output error જાતે correct નથી કરતું. યોગ્ય feedback correction સુધારે છે, પણ sensor/actuator dependence તથા wrong action/high gain થી instability આવી શકે છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A controller converts measured error and its selected history/rate information into a control output.

Detailed explanation and conditions

The syllabus controllers are P, PI and PID. P uses present error; I adds accumulated error; D uses change rate. The following are ideal functional forms implemented by computation or appropriate hardware, not instructions for constructing or tuning a real controller. MV limits, action direction, scaling and sampling must be specified in actual service.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Measured error તથા પસંદ કરેલી history/rate information ને control output માં ફેરવતું controller છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Syllabus controllers P, PI તથા PID છે. P present error, I accumulated error અને D rate વાપરે છે. Next diagrams ideal functional forms છે; real controller build/tune કરવાની instructions નથી. Actual service માં MV limits, action direction, scaling તથા sampling specify કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A controller whose output change is proportional to current error.

Principle

A gain multiplies SP−PV and is added to a bias output.

Construction

The functional realization contains SP/PV input scaling, a comparator, a proportional-gain path and an output/bias summation followed by limits and output conversion. In an electronic/digital controller these are circuits/software blocks rather than a mandatory mechanical linkage. The diagram shows the same comparator, gain and bias paths used by the stated equation.

Working

When PV differs from SP, the error is multiplied by Kc and the output moves about the selected bias. The final element then changes the process input. When error decreases, the proportional contribution decreases. A constant load often requires a nonzero error to sustain a changed output, producing offset unless the process/bias situation avoids it. Sign and direct/reverse action must match the process; positive gain alone does not guarantee negative feedback.

Applications

Simple loops tolerating offset or with suitable inherent process behaviour.

Limitations, selection and precautions

High gain may cause oscillation/noise sensitivity. P alone does not generally remove constant-load offset.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Current error પ્રમાણે proportional output change આપતું controller છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

SP−PV ને gain થી multiply કરીને bias output ઉમેરાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Functional realization માં SP/PV scaling, comparator, proportional gain path, bias summation તથા output limits/conversion છે. Electronic/digital controller માં આ circuit/software blocks છે, compulsory mechanical linkage નહીં. Diagram equation મુજબ comparator, gain તથા bias path બતાવે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

PV SP થી જુદું થાય ત્યારે error×Kc contribution bias પર ઉમેરાય છે. Final element process input બદલે છે. Error ઘટતાં Pcontribution ઘટે છે. Constant load સામે output change રાખવા ઘણીવાર nonzero error જોઈએ એટલે offset આવે છે; કેટલાક process/bias cases અલગ હોઈ શકે છે. Action sign process પ્રમાણે લો. Positive gain એકલું negative feedback guarantee નથી કરતું.

ઉપયોગો

Offset tolerable હોય અથવા suitable process behaviour ધરાવતા simple loops.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

High gain થી oscillation/noise sensitivity થઈ શકે છે. P સામાન્ય રીતે constant-load offset દૂર ન કરે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A controller combining proportional response with accumulated error correction.

Principle

Integral action keeps changing output while sustained error remains.

Construction

A scaled error signal feeds proportional and integral paths in parallel. The integral path has gain Kc/Ti and an integrator; both contributions and bias are summed. Output limits and an anti-windup arrangement are important practical additions. The diagram shows the error history entering the integral path, not a direct derivative path.

Working

The proportional path reacts immediately and the integral term accumulates the error over time. If stable control and actuator authority permit, the accumulated contribution supplies the extra steady output needed to return error toward zero under a constant disturbance. A smaller Ti makes integral action stronger in the shown form. Saturation can let the integral term grow without useful output change, so anti-windup prevents excessive recovery delay.

Applications

Common process temperature, pressure, level and flow loops when PI dynamics suit the plant.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Can remove constant offset under suitable stable conditions, but poor tuning causes overshoot/oscillation and windup.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Proportional response સાથે accumulated-error correction આપતું controller છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Sustained error રહે ત્યાં સુધી integral action output બદલતું રહે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Scaled error proportional તથા integral parallel paths માં જાય છે. Integral path માં Kc/Ti gain તથા integrator છે. બંને outputs સાથે bias sum થાય છે. Output limits તથા anti-windup practical additions છે. Diagram error history નું integration બતાવે છે, derivative નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Ppath immediate react કરે છે અને Iterm સમય સાથે error accumulate કરે છે. Stable loop તથા actuator authority હોય ત્યારે Iterm constant disturbance સામે જરૂરી steady output આપી error zero તરફ લાવે છે. આ form માં નાનું Ti stronger integral action આપે છે. Saturation માં integral term વધતો રહે તો recovery ધીમું થાય છે; anti-windup જરૂરી છે.

ઉપયોગો

PI dynamics યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં temperature, pressure, level તથા flow loops.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Suitable stable conditions માં constant offset દૂર કરી શકે છે; poor tuning થી overshoot/oscillation તથા windup થાય છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A controller combining present, accumulated and rate-of-change error contributions.

Principle

P responds to error, I addresses sustained error and D responds to its changing rate in the ideal error-form representation.

Construction

The functional diagram has parallel P, I and D paths summed with a bias. A practical implementation adds derivative filtering, output limits, anti-windup and selected set-point handling. Derivative on measured PV is often used to reduce set-point kick; the ideal equation shown uses error derivative and must not be confused with every manufacturer’s implementation.

Working

The three paths compute simultaneous contributions. P reacts now, I accumulates persistent error, and D changes output when the error changes rapidly. Appropriate derivative action can improve damping and transient behaviour when the process and measurement quality support it. It does not predict arbitrary future disturbances. Derivative magnifies high-frequency noise, so an unfiltered ideal differentiator is not the practical controller.

Applications

Selected slower process loops where derivative benefit exceeds noise/complexity penalties.

Limitations, selection and precautions

More parameters and noise sensitivity; benefit is not universal and safe tuning requires authorized plant procedures.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Present, accumulated તથા rate-of-change error contributions combine કરતું controller છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Ideal error-form માં Perror, I sustained error અને Dchanging rate ને respond કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Functional diagram માં parallel P, I, D paths તથા bias sum થાય છે. Practical implementation derivative filtering, limits, anti-windup તથા set-point handling ઉમેરે છે. Set-point kick ઘટાડવા ઘણીવાર PV પર derivative લેવાય છે. Shown ideal equation error derivative વાપરે છે; દરેક manufacturer implementation સમાન નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

ત્રણેય paths એકસાથે contribution આપે છે. Ppresent error, I persistent error અને Drapid change પર output બદલે છે. યોગ્ય process તથા clean measurement સાથે Ddamping/transient response સુધારી શકે છે. તે arbitrary future disturbances predict નથી કરતું. Dhigh-frequency noise amplify કરે છે; unfiltered ideal differentiator practical controller નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Derivative benefit noise/complexity કરતાં વધારે હોય તેવા selected slower process loops.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

વધુ parameters/noise sensitivity છે. Benefit universal નથી. Safe tuning માટે authorized plant procedure જોઈએ.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition: a system for supervisory monitoring, data acquisition and selected remote commands.

Principle

Field devices and local controllers communicate measurements/status to supervisory computers; commands return through a controlled communication path.

Construction

The architecture includes sensors/actuators, local PLCs/RTUs, a communication network, SCADA servers, an HMI, alarms and historical storage. Field sites may be geographically separated. Access control, time synchronization, network security and communication health are supporting functions. The drawing separates local control from the supervisory computer so network latency is not mistaken for a guaranteed fast control path.

Working

Local controllers acquire signals and perform configured local actions. SCADA polls or receives updates, displays trends/alarms and stores history. An authorized operator can issue supervisory commands, set points or permitted changes. The local controller checks and executes them under its logic. Communication failure must be handled by defined local fallback; SCADA display availability is not a substitute for independent process protection.

Applications

Water distribution, pipelines, remote utilities and geographically distributed plants.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Advantages: wide-area visibility, history and remote supervision. Limitations: network dependence, latency, cybersecurity and integration/maintenance needs. No assumption that every SCADA server directly closes fast loops.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition એટલે supervisory monitoring, data collection તથા selected remote commands ની system.

સિદ્ધાંત

Field devices/local controllers measurements/status supervisory computers સુધી આપે છે. Controlled communication path થી commands પાછા જાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Architecture માં sensors/actuators, local PLCs/RTUs, network, SCADA servers, HMI, alarms તથા historian છે. Field sites geographically separated હોઈ શકે છે. Access control, time sync, security તથા communication health supporting functions છે. Drawing local control ને supervisory computer થી અલગ બતાવે છે જેથી network latency ને fast guaranteed loop ન માની લેવાય.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Local controllers signals મેળવે છે તથા configured local actions કરે છે. SCADA updates લઈને trends/alarms બતાવે છે અને history store કરે છે. Authorized operator supervisory commands/SPchanges આપી શકે છે. Local controller logic મુજબ execute કરે છે. Communication failure માટે local fallback જોઈએ. Display availability independent protection નો વિકલ્પ નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Water distribution, pipelines, remote utilities તથા distributed plants.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Advantages: wide-area visibility, history તથા remote supervision. Limitations: network dependence, latency, cybersecurity તથા integration/maintenance. Fast loops હંમેશાં server માં close થાય એવું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

An integrated automation system distributing control functions among process controllers with coordinated operator/engineering facilities.

Principle

Local controllers execute control near I/O while a system network integrates supervision, configuration, alarms and history.

Construction

Typical DCS architecture has field instruments, distributed I/O and process controllers, a control network, operator stations and engineering/configuration facilities. Historian/alarm services and redundancy may be included according to design. The diagram shows more than one controller; redundancy is a selectable engineered feature, not a claim that every element is duplicated in every DCS.

Working

Controllers read local inputs, execute configured continuous/batch control and drive outputs. Operator stations show a unified plant view and allow authorized set-point/mode changes. Engineering tools configure blocks, alarms and logic. Coordinated networking shares information while local controllers carry out their assigned loops. System design determines failure isolation, availability and how control behaves if a station or network fails.

Applications

Continuous and batch chemical plants, refineries and large integrated process units.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Advantages: integrated engineering, distributed loops and coordinated operations. Limitations: cost, configuration expertise, vendor integration and maintenance complexity. Modern PLC/DCS capability overlaps; not a rigid analog-versus-digital division.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Process controllers વચ્ચે control functions distribute કરીને coordinated operator/engineering facilities આપતી integrated automation system છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Local controllers I/O નજીક control execute કરે છે. System network supervision, configuration, alarms તથા history integrate કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Typical architecture માં field instruments, distributed I/O/process controllers, control network, operator તથા engineering stations છે. Design પ્રમાણે historian/alarms તથા redundancy હોઈ શકે છે. Drawing multiple controllers બતાવે છે. Redundancy engineered feature છે; દરેક DCS માં દરેક element duplicate હોય એવું નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Controllers local inputs વાંચી configured continuous/batch control કરીને outputs આપે છે. Operator stations unified plant view તથા authorized SP/mode changes આપે છે. Engineering tools blocks, alarms તથા logic configure કરે છે. Network information share કરે છે, પણ assigned loops local controllers કરે છે. Failure isolation, availability તથા fallback design પર આધારિત છે.

ઉપયોગો

Continuous/batch chemical plants, refineries તથા large integrated process units.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Advantages: integrated engineering, distributed loops તથા coordinated operation. Limitations: cost, expertise, vendor integration તથા maintenance complexity. Modern PLC/DCS capabilities overlap થાય છે; analog/digital ની rigid division નથી.

body.en:
Definition

An industrial programmable controller that reads inputs, executes a stored control program and updates outputs.

Principle

The conventional cyclic scan performs input acquisition, program execution and output update, with additional tasks/interrupts as designed.

Construction

A PLC includes a power supply, CPU/program memory, input and output modules, communication interfaces and a programming facility. Sensors/switches connect through suitable isolated input modules; output modules drive appropriate interfaces to valves, motors or relays. Analog and communication modules allow process signals; the sketch is a functional architecture, not a field wiring instruction.

Working

In a typical scan, the controller copies input states, executes logic/timers/counters and computes output states, then updates outputs and performs supporting tasks. The cycle repeats so sequencing and interlocks respond to changing inputs. Some modules/tasks update asynchronously, so scan behaviour must match the actual platform. Modern PLCs may run analog PID and motion functions; an ordinary PLC is not automatically a certified safety PLC.

Applications

Equipment sequencing, packaging, pump/valve interlocks and appropriate process automation.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Advantages: rugged, reprogrammable and modular. Limitations: I/O/cycle constraints, programming/diagnostic expertise, security and application-specific certification needs. Changes to running logic require authorization and validation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Inputs વાંચી stored program execute કરીને outputs update કરતું industrial programmable controller છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Conventional cyclic scan input acquisition, program execution તથા output update કરે છે. Design મુજબ tasks/interrupts પણ હોઈ શકે છે.

રચના (Construction)

PLC માં power supply, CPU/program memory, I/Omodules, communication interfaces તથા programming facility છે. Sensors/switches suitable isolated inputs સાથે જોડાય છે. Output modules યોગ્ય interfaces વડે valves, motors/relays ચલાવે છે. Analog/communication modules process signals લે છે. Sketch functional architecture છે, field wiring instruction નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Typical scan માં input states copy, logic/timers/counters execute, outputs compute/update તથા supporting tasks થાય છે. Cycle repeat થતાં sequence/interlocks inputs ને respond કરે છે. Some modules/tasks asynchronous હોય છે, તેથી actual platform મુજબ વર્તન જુઓ. Modern PLC analog PID/motion પણ કરી શકે છે. Ordinary PLC આપમેળે certified safety PLC નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Equipment sequencing, packaging, pump/valve interlocks તથા suitable process automation.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Advantages: rugged, reprogrammable તથા modular. Limitations: I/O/cycle constraints, expertise, security તથા requiredcertification. Running logic changes માટે authorization/validation જોઈએ.

title.en: Closed-loop block diagram and control terms
title.gu: Closed-loop Block Diagram તથા Control Terms

q.en: State the definition and principle of Importance of process control.
q.gu: Process Control નું મહત્વ ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Process control manipulates selected inputs to keep process variables at desired conditions despite changes.
a.gu: બદલાવ છતાં process variables ને desired conditions પર રાખવા selected inputs બદલવાની વ્યવસ્થા Process Control છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Requirements of a good control system.
q.gu: સારી Control System ની Requirements ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A good control system meets its stated performance objectives while remaining stable and safe within operating constraints.
a.gu: Stated performance objectives ને operating constraints અંદર stable/safe રીતે meet કરતી વ્યવસ્થા સારી Control System છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Closed-loop block diagram and control terms.
q.gu: Closed-loop Block Diagram તથા Control Terms ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Set point SP is the desired controlled-variable value. PV is the measured process variable. Error is SP−PV under the declared convention. Controlled variable CV is the quantity to regulate; manipulated variable MV is the process input intentionally varied. A disturbance changes the process without being the intended control action.
a.gu: SP desired controlled-variable value છે. PV measured process variable છે. Declared convention પ્રમાણે Error=SP−PV છે. CV regulate કરાતી quantity અને MV intentionally બદલાતો process input છે. Disturbance intended control action સિવાય process બદલે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Servo versus regulatory control problems.
q.gu: Servo તથા Regulatory Control Problems ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A servo problem follows a changed set point. A regulatory problem rejects disturbances while maintaining the set point.
a.gu: Set point બદલાય ત્યારે તેને follow કરવો Servo Problem છે. SP સ્થિર રાખીને disturbance reject કરવો Regulatory Problem છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Feedback and feedforward control.
q.gu: Feedback તથા Feedforward Control ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Feedback uses measured process output to correct error. Feedforward uses measured disturbances and a process relationship to compute compensating action.
a.gu: Feedback measured process output પરથી error correct કરે છે. Feedforward measured disturbance તથા process relationship પરથી compensation કરે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Open-loop and closed-loop systems.
q.gu: Open-loop તથા Closed-loop Systems ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An open-loop system does not use the controlled output measurement to correct its action. A closed-loop system feeds output information back to influence action.
a.gu: Open-loop system controlled output measurement થી પોતાનું action correct કરતી નથી. Closed-loop system output information feedback કરીને action બદલે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Classification of controllers.
q.gu: Controllers નું વર્ગીકરણ ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A controller converts measured error and its selected history/rate information into a control output.
a.gu: Measured error તથા પસંદ કરેલી history/rate information ને control output માં ફેરવતું controller છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Proportional controller—P.
q.gu: Proportional Controller—P ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A controller whose output change is proportional to current error. A gain multiplies SP−PV and is added to a bias output.
a.gu: Current error પ્રમાણે proportional output change આપતું controller છે. SP−PV ને gain થી multiply કરીને bias output ઉમેરાય છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Proportional–integral controller—PI.
q.gu: Proportional–Integral Controller—PI ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A controller combining proportional response with accumulated error correction. Integral action keeps changing output while sustained error remains.
a.gu: Proportional response સાથે accumulated-error correction આપતું controller છે. Sustained error રહે ત્યાં સુધી integral action output બદલતું રહે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Proportional–integral–derivative controller—PID.
q.gu: Proportional–Integral–Derivative Controller—PID ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A controller combining present, accumulated and rate-of-change error contributions. P responds to error, I addresses sustained error and D responds to its changing rate in the ideal error-form representation.
a.gu: Present, accumulated તથા rate-of-change error contributions combine કરતું controller છે. Ideal error-form માં Perror, I sustained error અને Dchanging rate ને respond કરે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of SCADA.
q.gu: SCADA ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition: a system for supervisory monitoring, data acquisition and selected remote commands. Field devices and local controllers communicate measurements/status to supervisory computers; commands return through a controlled communication path.
a.gu: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition એટલે supervisory monitoring, data collection તથા selected remote commands ની system. Field devices/local controllers measurements/status supervisory computers સુધી આપે છે. Controlled communication path થી commands પાછા જાય છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Distributed Control System—DCS.
q.gu: Distributed Control System—DCS ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An integrated automation system distributing control functions among process controllers with coordinated operator/engineering facilities. Local controllers execute control near I/O while a system network integrates supervision, configuration, alarms and history.
a.gu: Process controllers વચ્ચે control functions distribute કરીને coordinated operator/engineering facilities આપતી integrated automation system છે. Local controllers I/O નજીક control execute કરે છે. System network supervision, configuration, alarms તથા history integrate કરે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Programmable Logic Controller—PLC.
q.gu: Programmable Logic Controller—PLC ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An industrial programmable controller that reads inputs, executes a stored control program and updates outputs. The conventional cyclic scan performs input acquisition, program execution and output update, with additional tasks/interrupts as designed.
a.gu: Inputs વાંચી stored program execute કરીને outputs update કરતું industrial programmable controller છે. Conventional cyclic scan input acquisition, program execution તથા output update કરે છે. Design મુજબ tasks/interrupts પણ હોઈ શકે છે.
